items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: She also produced shows at the Grand Terrace, until Percy Venable came.

ctx.x: Who was she? I heard a lot about her, that she played trumpet, too.
She played trumpet, and sang. She also produced shows at the Grand Terrace, until Percy Venable came.
Yeah, didn't she and Earl have a personal thing going on, too?
